title: Integer multiplicity currents carried by finitely many open unit faces have integer face densities: Q = Σ_F θ_F[[F°]] with Σ∫|θ_F| ≤ M(Q) (Simon Ch. 6, (26)–(28), (33); steps 2–3 of the parent proof)
statement: Conventions (as in the selected node): ℝ^P = Euclid P, ℝⁿ = Euclid n, Hᵈ = μHE[d], e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1 ∈ ℝ^P, x_i the i-th coordinate. n := m + 1. For a pair p = (z, ι) ∈ ℤ^P × (Fin n → Fin P): Φ_p(y) := z + Σ_{j<n} y_j e_{ι(j)} for y ∈ ℝⁿ (Lean: WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.1 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.2 j) (1 : ℝ)); e_p := (e_{ι(0)}, …, e_{ι(m)}); Q₁ := {y ∈ ℝⁿ : 0 < y_i < 1 for all i} with Lebesgue measure (volume); F_p := {x ∈ ℝ^P : z_i ≤ x_i ≤ z_i + 1 for i ∈ range ι, x_i = z_i for i ∉ range ι} (the closed unit face of the selected node's statement); A_p := Φ_p(Q₁) (the open face). 𝒟^d(U) = TestFormOn U d and 𝒟_d(U) = GeometricCurrentOn U d (domain univ throughout); ∂X = X.boundary; M_W(X) = X.massOn W and M(X) = X.mass (Euclidean coefficient norm covectorEuclideanNorm); IMRep and IsIntegerMultiplicity are the contract notions. Statement: let P, m ∈ ℕ, s a finite set of pairs p = (z, ι) with every ι strictly increasing, and E ⊆ ℝ^P closed such that for μHE[n]-almost every x ∈ E (a.e. for μHE[n]⌞E) there are p ∈ s and y ∈ Q₁ with Φ_p(y) = x. Let Q ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) be integer multiplicity (represented by an IMRep (M, θ, ξ) in univ: Q(ω) = ∫_M θ⟨ω, ξ⟩ dHⁿ) and vanish off E (Q(ω) = 0 for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) whose tsupport is disjoint from E). Then there are functions u_p : ℝⁿ → ℝ (p a pair) such that for every p ∈ s, u_p(y) ∈ ℤ for every y ∈ ℝⁿ and u_p is integrable on Q₁; ENNReal.ofReal(Σ_{p∈s} ∫_{Q₁}|u_p|) ≤ M(Q); and Q(ω) = Σ_{p∈s} ∫_{Q₁} u_p(y)·ω(Φ_p(y))(e_p) dy for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (s : Finset ((Fin P → ℤ) × (Fin (m + 1) → Fin P))) (E : Set (Euclid P)) (Q : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), (∀ p ∈ s, StrictMono p.2) → IsClosed E → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[m + 1].restrict E), ∃ p ∈ s, ∃ y : Euclid (m + 1), (∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1) ∧ WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.1 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.2 j) (1 : ℝ) = x) → IsIntegerMultiplicity Q → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1))) E → Q ω = 0) → ∃ u : (Fin P → ℤ) × (Fin (m + 1) → Fin P) → Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ, (∀ p ∈ s, ∀ y, ∃ z : ℤ, u p y = z) ∧ (∀ p ∈ s, IntegrableOn (u p) {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}) ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (∑ p ∈ s, ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, |u p y|) ≤ Q.mass ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), Q ω = ∑ p ∈ s, ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, u p y * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.1 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.2 j) (1 : ℝ)) (fun k => EuclideanSpace.single (p.2 k) (1 : ℝ))
